summary: Read docs/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.md (508 lines, 7 sections) in full and the codebase's one existing Typst precedent (typst/MPL/) to extract house style (thmbox theorem environments, AMS austere aesthetic, notation macros). Identified concrete redundancy-trim opportunities (Section 3's five near-duplicate Lean lemmas -> one table; Section 2's 24-edge prose list -> a fletcher cube diagram) and verified locally that a typst compile smoke test (Lean-fenced code block + box/diamond math + table) succeeds with thmbox 0.3.0 and fletcher cached offline. Report recommends a single self-contained file at typst/ModalAxiomArchitecture/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.typ (not a multi-file MPL-style scaffold), with build output to build/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.pdf.
decisions_made: Output path: typst/ModalAxiomArchitecture/modal-axiom-schema-architecture.typ, a single self-contained file (no separate template.typ/notation/ split) since the source is one ~500-line document, not a multi-chapter report like the existing typst/MPL/ precedent.

Reuse typst/MPL house style directly: @preview/thmbox:0.3.0 theorem environments (definition/theorem/lemma/axiom/remark), New Computer Modern font, austere no-fill AMS aesthetic, and the nec/poss (square.stroked/diamond.stroked) notation macros from typst/MPL/notation/shared-notation.typ.

Collapse Section 3's five near-identical Satisfies.modal*_axiom Lean signatures into one table (Tag | schema | frame condition | lemma name) -- the single largest verbosity-trim opportunity in the source.

Replace Section 2's 24-edge prose bulleted list with a fletcher package diagram of the modal cube (15 nodes, 24 edges); treated as a stretch enhancement, not a blocking requirement, with a grouped-table fallback if layout proves too fiddly.

Keep ~6-7 singular, load-bearing Lean signatures (ModalSchemaTag inductive, SchemaUnion def, the three @[simp] elimination lemmas, FrameValidatesTag, unionSound, the HasAxiomT instance witness) as literal fenced Lean code blocks for fidelity -- this document's whole point is precise verified signatures, unlike the more narrative typst/MPL precedent which never uses raw Lean code blocks.

Compiled a local typst smoke test confirming Lean-fenced raw code blocks, square.stroked/diamond.stroked math, and tables all render correctly with typst 0.14.2 and locally cached thmbox 0.3.0 / fletcher packages -- no network fetch required at implementation time.
dead_ends: Co-locating the .typ file in docs/ alongside the .md source was considered and rejected -- typst/ is this repo's established convention for Typst deliverables (with its own build/ output subdirectory), and docs/ currently holds only Markdown.
